name: Yangliuqing New Year Print
about: A traditional colorful print from Tianjin's Yangliuqing town, known for its folk art. It is one of the city's best-known crafts.
tip: Check whether the print is hand-painted or machine-printed. Hand-painted ones cost more.

name: Nirenzhang Clay Figurine
where: Ni Ren Zhang, official shop on Ancient Culture Street
about: A traditional clay figure of people, made in Tianjin for over a century. It shows the city's classic folk sculpture style.
tip: Look for the official brand mark to make sure you are buying a genuine piece.

name: Mahua Pastry
about: A crisp, twisted fried dough snack sold across Tianjin. It is a classic local treat that makes an easy gift.
